purpose: Allow PR workflow self-triggers to be removed without losing review safety: common action-pin-only changes are covered centrally, deliberate self-trigger removal is recognized as bounded topology debt reduction, and all other workflow logic changes must still wake their own domain verifier through a relevant changed source path.
laws: If a changed workflow still wakes on its own definition file, its existing verifier remains the proof path.
If a changed workflow no longer self-wakes, a pin-only update is allowed only for action families exercised by the central Control Plane compatibility canary.
Removing only the workflow's own path entry from pull_request.paths is allowed only when the workflow keeps pull_request enabled and retains at least one non-workflow domain path.
Any other workflow logic change that does not self-wake must be paired with a changed non-workflow path that wakes the current workflow verifier.
Added or deleted workflow definitions without a verifiable proof path fail closed.
